title: haloragis teucrioides
intro: Haloragis teucrioides, commonly known as the New Zealand pepperwort or New Zealand dilly dilly, is a species of flowering plant in the family Haloragaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as its ability to act as an antiseptic and antimicrobial agent. The health benefits of Haloragis teucrioides are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, as well as its potential to aid in wound healing and skin repair. The bioactive constituents of Haloragis teucrioides include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
